appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Adjust UI theme and font display

ai.label: Show AI panel by default
ai.description: Auto-expand AI chat panel when opening the editor

statusBar.label: Status bar
statusBar.description: Show word count, cursor position at the bottom

hiddenFiles.label: Show hidden files
hiddenFiles.description: Show dotfiles and hidden folders in the file tree

wiki.label: Wiki panel
wiki.description: Show Wiki entry in the sidebar

clips.label: Clips panel
clips.description: Show web-clips entry in the sidebar

analyze.label: Project analysis panel
analyze.description: Show project-analysis entry in the sidebar

daily.label: Daily notes panel
daily.description: Show calendar and daily notes entry in the sidebar (disabling also disables ⌘D)

excludePatterns.label: Filter files/folders
excludePatterns.description: One rule per line; matched files/folders are hidden in the file tree. Supports * and ? wildcards; lines starting with # are comments.

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: Configure editor behavior and display options

showLineNumbers.label: Show line numbers
showLineNumbers.description: Show line numbers on the left of the editor

linkOpenMode.label: Link open mode
linkOpenMode.description: Default behavior when clicking a link

dailyNotes.title: Daily Notes
dailyNotes.description: Configure storage directory and date format for daily notes

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Click a shortcut field to re-record; press a new key combo to change it

editor.conflictHint: No key captured — this combo may be taken by the app menu or OS (⌘Q / ⌘H / ⌘M / ⌘W / ⌘⇧P)

ai.title: AI tools
ai.description: Configure AI CLI tools for smart document editing

cliPath.label: CLI path
cliPath.hint: Path or command name of the CLI executable; click "Detect" to auto-find

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: AI tools edit documents by calling a local CLI (e.g. Claude Code). Make sure the corresponding CLI is installed. Edits are shown as diffs and applied after confirmation.

chat.title: Chat mode
chat.description: Multi-turn chat via rig direct LLM (no CLI, no tool/file access). ask/agent still use the CLI above.

baseUrl.label: Base URL (optional)
baseUrl.anthropicHint: Leave empty for official Anthropic; Anthropic-compatible endpoints
baseUrl.openaiCompatibleHint: Required for Ollama / vLLM / LM Studio etc.; /v1 is appended automatically if missing.

localFirst.title: Local-first
localFirst.description: Data is stored on your device

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: Install, approve, enable or uninstall third-party plugins (microkernel + plugin SDK)
plugins.empty: No plugins installed yet. Place a plugin folder anywhere, then click "Install from folder".
plugins.emptyExample: Sample plugins live in the repo at

consent.title: Approve trusted plugin
consent.warning: Trusted plugins run in the main process and have full host capabilities (read/write the vault, invoke Tauri commands, access all React state). Approval equals full trust — only approve plugins from sources you trust. Uninstall removes its contribution points at any time.

voice.title: Voice input
voice.description: Click 🎤 in the AI chat or press the global hotkey to start recording; speech is transcribed, polished, and inserted into the focused input (works across apps).
voice.windowsUnsupported: . Voice input is not supported on Windows
voice.windowsUnsupportedBanner: Voice input is not supported on this platform. macOS uses Apple Speech (SFSpeechRecognizer).

permission.denied: Still not granted — click to retry

accessibility.title: Accessibility permission
accessibility.desc: Cross-app text insertion requires accessibility permission. Click the button to trigger the system prompt; restart the app after granting (TCC caches the decision at process start).

microphone.title: Microphone permission
microphone.desc: Recording requires microphone permission. Click the button to trigger the system prompt; if previously denied, allow Quill under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone, then retry.

speech.title: Speech recognition permission
speech.desc: Apple Speech transcription requires speech recognition permission. Click the button to trigger the system prompt; if previously denied, allow Quill under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Speech Recognition, then retry.

polishPrompt.label: Polish prompt
polishPrompt.desc: Polish the raw transcript using the current AI config (see AI tools). Leave empty to skip polishing.

autoPolish.title: Auto polish
autoPolish.desc: After recording, automatically run the polish prompt on the transcript; disable to output raw transcript

saveSource.title: Save voice source file
saveSource.desc: Save the raw recording (WAV) to a specified directory under the vault

sourceDir.label: Source directory
sourceDir.desc: Relative to the current vault root; saved file is <dir>/<timestamp>.wav

spokenLanguage.label: Recognition language
spokenLanguage.desc: Apple Speech routes recognition by language; pick "Simplified Chinese" for Chinese speech. The system default locale may not match the spoken language; specify explicitly to avoid empty transcripts.

globalHotkey.label: Global hotkey
globalHotkey.desc: Leave empty to disable; when set, hold the hotkey to start recording, release to finish and insert into the focused input (cross-app). Esc clears.

templates.title: File Templates
templates.description: Configure the default template content for new files by extension. Variables: {{title}}, {{filename}}, {{date}}, {{ext}}

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Configure AI skill templates; custom prompts control the format and quality of AI-generated content

capability.title: Capability binding
capability.desc: Assign a skill to each capability; Claude Code follows the corresponding skill's instructions to complete the task.

form.idHint: Slug format; lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens only
form.promptPlaceholder: Enter a prompt template; use {{variableName}} for variables...

skills.confirmReset: Reset to defaults? Unsaved changes will be lost.
skills.confirmDelete: Delete this skill? This cannot be undone.

pet.title: Pet
pet.description: Configure the desktop pet icon and display

showPet.title: Show pet
showPet.desc: Show the desktop pet window on screen (macOS)

icon.title: Icon
icon.desc: Use the built-in Quill icon, or upload a custom image

errors.desktopOnly: Desktop feature; please use in a Tauri environment
errors.unsupportedFormat: Only png / jpg / webp / svg formats are supported

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose the form of desktop pet event notifications

form.title: Notification form
form.desc: Bubble floats above the pet; system notifications go through the macOS Notification Center (visible even when unfocused)
